# Product Review Checklist

- [ ] Problem statement is clear.
- [ ] Primary user and core workflow are defined.
- [ ] MVP scope is minimal and valuable.
- [ ] Out-of-scope list prevents foreseeable scope creep.
- [ ] Success metrics are measurable.
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are verifiable.
- [ ] User-facing limitations are documented.
- [ ] Competitor/alternative assumptions are evidence-backed.
